question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Encompassing**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Encompassing **means including or covering a wide range of things. (चीजों की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला को शामिल करना या कवर करना) • **Example**: *The conference had a comprehensive agenda, encompassing topics ranging from environmental sustainability to technological innovation.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence. • The base verb form of encompassing is 'encompass', which means to surround or contain. • Encompassing is a present participle and can be used as an adjective or a gerund. Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Preventing **means stopping something from happening. (किसी चीज़ को घटित होने से रोकना) • **Excluding **means not allowing something or someone to be included. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को शामिल करने की अनुमति नहीं देना) • **Restraining **means holding back or limiting something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को रोकना या सीमित करना) 45:T91d, The correct answer is: **Dispose**
